learnings: Tool robustness: Implement better error handling and retry logic for API failures (HTTP 400 errors) to prevent inconclusive verdicts due to transient issues
Fallback mechanisms: When full file review fails due to tool errors, the initial audit results should be weighted more heavily in the final verdict determination
Model selection: Free-tier models (like openrouter/free) may have parsing or response format issues that need validation before being used for security-critical audits

Consistency check: When multiple models review the same package and some fail due to tool errors, verify that successful reviews are consistent with initial audits from failed reviews before marking as inconclusive
